definitions.gloss: sales; sales performance; how well something sells
definitions.explanation: The pace or trend of sales for a product. Indicates whether something is selling well or poorly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The new product is selling well.

examples.japanese: {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧きた。

⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急激|きゅうげき}→急激：02633_kyuugeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: After being featured on TV, sales of this book grew rapidly.

notes:
{売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き is a compound noun formed from ⟦{売|う}れる→売れる：02012_ureru⟧ (to sell) and {行|ゆ}き (course, trend). It focuses on the trend or pace of sales rather than the total sales figure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (selling well)
- {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (selling poorly)
- {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びる→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧ (sales grow)
- {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (sales decline)
- {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (to watch sales performance)

RELATED WORDS:
⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧ (sales revenue) refers to the actual monetary amount of sales. {売|う}れ{行|ゆ}き refers more to the pace and trend — whether items are flying off the shelves or sitting unsold.
